Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. KH initial growth in a smooth periodic shear layer Evolve the actual nonlinear2D vorticity PDE and compare finite-time growth and spatial errors with an independent continuous Fourier–Galerkin linear IVP. Assumptions, units and boundaries Periodic[0,2pi]², layer width.25, nu=kappa=.005, epsilon1e-5 and32²/64²/128² grids. Explicit forcing maintains the base. U=tanh(sin y/delta),T1. Editorial clarification Small-amplitude fixed educational cases. The independent reference changes spatial representation but linearizes the PDE; it is not a second nonlinear engine. No sharp-interface infinite-domain dispersion, original compressible McNally inputs, late roll-up or RT turbulence claim. Figures explicitly normalize computed perturbations by epsilon. Adopted numerical method Advance point-sampled perturbations using centered shared-face conservative fluxes and Heun; invert the five-point Poisson symbol by FFT. Centered derivatives define divergence-free velocity. Analytic base subtraction avoids a discretization imbalance larger than the small perturbation. −Δψ=ω,(u,v)=(∂yψ,−∂xψ)−Δψ=ω,(u,v)=(∂y​ψ,−∂x​ψ) U(y)=tanh⁡(sin⁡y/δ),ωt+Uωx+U′′ψx+u⋅∇ω=νΔωU(y)=tanh(siny/δ),ωt​+Uωx​+U′′ψx​+u⋅∇ω=νΔω σT=1Tlog⁡A(T)A(0),q^˙=LKq^σT​=T1​logA(0)A(T)​,q​˙​=LK​q​ References and measured quantities Freeze22pytest tests,74case gates and10nonlinear evolutions.
